headline: EPAM Systems Shares Rise on Earnings Beat and Raised Guidance
summary: EPAM Systems shares surged 5% following a quarterly earnings report that exceeded analyst expectations and an upward revision of the company's financial guidance.
why: EPAM is a major provider of digital engineering and software development services. Earnings beats and guidance hikes are primary drivers of short-term equity performance.

impacts.name: EPAM Systems
impacts.why: The company reported better-than-expected earnings and raised its outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Positive earnings surprises and raised guidance directly increase investor valuation of the company's future cash flows.
